## findings

1. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED — cross-difficulty refund row contradicts the trip charter (G5 on this task).** Symptom: the forfeiture's partial-share tier (0.60) and fault-reason tier (20 %) are read off trip_charges df49b10e (`trip_refund`, −25.14 against fare 3de7ed05 of 41.90, adjustment_reason wrong_dropoff_location, pass_membership_id empty). Root cause: the trip charter defines trip_refund as "A whole charge is returned to the rider's original payment method" with amount "equal to the refunded charge less any earlier adjustment of it" (no adjustment exists, so −41.90), lists the trip_refund reasons without wrong_dropoff_location, sends "any wrong drop-off location claim ... to the fare review team as a fare review for the disputed charge instead of being adjusted", and defines the refund's pass_membership_id as "Membership that earned Pass credit on the refunded fare" (its trigger then books pass:pass_credit_forfeit). Consequence: under a charter-conformant row the refund would be whole (tier "refunded in full", clawback 4.67) and its reason could not be a fault reason; the scored 1.12 rests on a row the trip product cannot produce; striking the two factors leaves 3 factors (below 4, no method). Affected: initial_state.trip_charges.df49b10e-2e17-48e1-8669-455af298a8a1; `pass.extended.yaml` pass_ext_refunded_fare_credit_forfeit factors refund_share_clawback / refund_reason_forfeiture_relief; computations[1].
2. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED (G1 on this task)** — `unused_period_basis` card-partner tier unreachable / undeclared override; no consequence on the scored 191.74 (rider_app signup).
3. **SOURCE-CHAIN RED (false proof figure).** prerequisite_closure.edge_load_bearing[1] and design_rationale state the skipped-posting refund as 185.08 and upgrade 196.40; the window-refund rule rounds "half up to the cent" (13.90 × 0.75 = 10.425 → 10.43), giving 185.07 and 196.39. Root cause: `RND` is float `round` (O6). Consequence: the closure's assertion is false by 0.01; the edge's load-bearing conclusion stands (185.07 ≠ 180.00).
4. **SOURCE-POLICY RED (charter-global G3, G4) — cited, no consequence here.** On this world fare 44.90 > upfront 38.75 (G3-a coincide), drop-off month 2026-10 = latest credit_month (G3-b coincide), the only refund on 84f9b68c is against its fare (G3-d coincide), and no completed trip sits inside its 48-hour posting delay (G4).
5. Observations: T1 — the persona's conditional line names the three agent-side write kinds ("post, correct or refund"); reactive as written. T2 — the forfeiture prerequisite is unmet at the opening only because df49b10e lacks the pass_membership_id the trip charter's trigger would act on. O4, O5, O6 (`_difficulty.md`). GT's extra find_driver_agreements read is harmless.
